# First Mate

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P37](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0037), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P42](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0042), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P9](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0009)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

The First Mate is a huge, orange-colored cat described as a gorgeous beastie. He has a face as round as a full moon, vivid green eyes, and immense, white, double paws. When curled up, he resembles a big, warm, velvety, golden ball.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P25](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0025), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P37](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0037), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P7](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P39](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0039)_

## History

The First Mate was an orange cat who was rescued nine years earlier by Captain Jim after being found starving in a tree, entangled by his ribbon collar. Residing at the [Four Winds Point](../codex/places.md#four-winds-point) lighthouse, he spent his time keeping Captain Jim company and entertaining visiting guests like [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) during their frequent social gatherings and New Year's celebrations. As Captain Jim neared the end of his life, he poignantly asked [Anne](../character/anne.md) to take care of the First Mate after his impending death. Following Captain Jim's peaceful passing in his sleep, the First Mate lost his long-time companion at the lighthouse.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P0](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P1](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P2](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P3](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P8](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P9](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0009), +188 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--first-mate.md)

The First Mate is Captain Jim's orange cat, whom [Anne](../character/anne.md) meets during her visits to the [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds) lighthouse. Although identified as a pet in her home, the cat primarily resides at the lighthouse where Captain Jim entertains [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). The First Mate is a constant presence during their social gatherings and New Year's celebrations at the light.

- Friend of — beloved pet in her home  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P5](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0005)</sub>

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/first-mate--gilbert-blythe.md)

[Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) encounters the First Mate during his frequent evening visits to the [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds) lighthouse with [Anne](../character/anne.md). The large orange cat lives at the lighthouse with Captain Jim, who introduced him to [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) alongside his other curiosities and stories. Though classified as a beloved pet in Gilbert's home, the feline is part of the welcoming atmosphere [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) enjoys during gatherings at the point.

- Friend of — beloved pet in his home  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P5](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0005)</sub>

### [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/first-mate--leslie-moore.md)

[Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) interacts with the First Mate during her autumn visits and festive gatherings at Captain Jim's lighthouse. As Captain Jim's pet, the orange cat serves as part of the cozy domestic backdrop whenever [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md), and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) join the Captain for tea, storytelling, and celebrations.

- Friend of — beloved pet in the home  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P5](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0005)</sub>
